import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True

sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from src.render import render_rows

# Basic shape, order preserved, exact joiner.
got = render_rows([
    {"name": "alpha", "score": 1.5},
    {"name": "beta", "score": 3.0},
])
assert got == "alpha | 1.50\nbeta | 3.00", repr(got)

# Empty input is an empty string, not a newline.
assert render_rows([]) == "", repr(render_rows([]))

# Missing score is a literal hyphen.
got = render_rows([{"name": "gamma", "score": None}])
assert got == "gamma | -", repr(got)

# Truncation: ellipsis counts toward the 8-character width.
got = render_rows([{"name": "abcdefghij", "score": 2.0}])
assert got == "abcdefg… | 2.00", repr(got)

# Exactly 8 characters is untouched.
got = render_rows([{"name": "abcdefgh", "score": 2.0}])
assert got == "abcdefgh | 2.00", repr(got)

# Nine characters truncates.
got = render_rows([{"name": "abcdefghi", "score": 2.0}])
assert got == "abcdefg… | 2.00", repr(got)

# Half-up rounding, where round() would round to even.
got = render_rows([{"name": "h", "score": 0.125}])
assert got == "h | 0.13", repr(got) + "  (banker's rounding gives 0.12)"
got = render_rows([{"name": "h", "score": 0.625}])
assert got == "h | 0.63", repr(got) + "  (banker's rounding gives 0.62)"

# Trailing zeros are kept.
assert render_rows([{"name": "z", "score": 0.0}]) == "z | 0.00"

# No trailing newline on multi-row output.
got = render_rows([{"name": "a", "score": 1.0}, {"name": "b", "score": 2.0}])
assert not got.endswith("\n"), "no trailing newline"
assert got.count("\n") == 1, repr(got)

print("RENDER_OK")
